title: Great For Thin Garments
text: Great For Thin Garments. These are great for shirts and blouses but not so good for suits and coats. They are just not wide enough, at only 2 inches. The sleeves are being crushed in. I think they should have made them 3" for suits and coats.

product_metadata.title: Clear Vinyl Shoulder Covers Closet Suit Protects Storage Home Decor Size: 12"H x 22"W x 2"D, (12 Shoulder Covers)
features: Each cover holds one or two garments

description: Save money on dry cleaning and keep your favorite blouses, sweaters and dresses dust free with these crystal clear vinyl shoulder covers.
